question: National Museum of Indian Cinema was inaugurated in January 2019 in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Museum of Indian Cinema** was inaugurated in January 2019 in **Mumbai**.
 
• The museum aims to showcase the history of Indian cinema and its impact on social and cultural evolution.
 
• It is located at the Films Division Complex on Peddar Road in South Mumbai.
 
• The museum features interactive displays, memorabilia, and digital installations that trace the journey of Indian cinema from its inception to the present day.
 
• The museum is divided into two buildings: the New Museum Building and the Gulshan Mahal, a 19th-century heritage bungalow.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **National Museum of Indian Cinema** is a tribute to the rich legacy and vibrant history of Indian cinema.
 
• The museum provides an educational experience for visitors, including students, researchers, and cinema enthusiasts.
 
• The museum also hosts various film screenings, workshops, and seminars to promote the understanding and appreciation of Indian cinema.
 
• It serves as a significant cultural landmark and a tourist attraction in Mumbai.
 
• The museum was inaugurated by the Honorable Prime Minister of India, Narendra Modi, on January 19, 2019.
